content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Faculty Coordinator Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati, Research and Development Section
Rs. 90,000 (L1), Rs. 1,15,000 (L2) or Rs. 1,40,000 (L3), plus HRA and medical; total Rs. 1,09,250 to Rs. 1,69,250

content_sections.heading: About IIT Guwahati
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located at Guwahati-781039, Assam. This notice comes from its Research and Development Section. The post is a project post in the Department of Chemical Engineering, under the project named in the opening paragraph above, which is linked to CIT Chennai.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The project number printed on the notice is 2627C-0280-CLEG0985SENT. The Principal Investigator is Prof. Senthilmurugan Subbiah.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice also prints these desirable and other requirements for the post:

rows.qualification: Essential: A PhD in engineering or technology. Candidates without a PhD degree are not eligible.
rows.experience: Relevant post-PhD experience decides the pay level: L1 needs 1+ years, L2 needs 3+ years, L3 needs at least 5+ years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The Selection Committee fixes the pay at one of these levels, with approval of the competent authority, based on relevant post-PhD experience and performance in the interview. HRA at 20% of basic pay and medical benefits are admissible as per IIT Guwahati norms. The duration of appointment is 11 months.

rows.post_phd_experience: At least 5+ years, including coordination of multi-institution, sponsored or industry-linked R&D programmes

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Faculty Coordinator
content_sections.text: The online interview is scheduled for 4 December 2026 at 10:00 am. For technical help with the online application, call 0361-258-2759 or write to [email protected] . For any clarification, contact Prof. Senthilmurugan Subbiah, Principal Investigator, at [email protected] or phone 91 361 258 3527.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the performance of the candidate in the interview. The Selection Committee also uses relevant post-PhD experience and interview performance to fix the pay level.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates without a PhD degree are not eligible. No campus accommodation will be available for the selected candidates. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the test and interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many Faculty Coordinator vacancies are there at IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for Faculty Coordinator in the Department of Chemical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IIT Guwahati Faculty Coordinator?
faq.answer: The last date is 2 December 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Faculty Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is a PhD in engineering or technology. Candidates without a PhD degree are not eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IIT Guwahati Faculty Coordinator?
faq.answer: Pay is Rs. 90,000 (L1), Rs. 1,15,000 (L2) or Rs. 1,40,000 (L3), with HRA at 20% and medical benefits. The total amount is Rs. 1,09,250, Rs. 1,39,250 or Rs. 1,69,250 respectively.

faq.question: Q5. How is the pay level decided?
faq.answer: The Selection Committee fixes it, with approval of the competent authority, based on relevant post-PhD experience and interview performance. L1 needs 1+ years, L2 needs 3+ years and L3 needs at least 5+ years.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online on the Recruitment Portal of Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati, at https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment, by searching for the project title given in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on the candidate's performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. When and how is the interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is online on 4 December 2026 at 10:00 am. Shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail about the mode of interview.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The duration of appointment is 11 months.

faq.question: Q10. Will accommodation or travel allowance be given?
faq.answer: No. No campus accommodation will be available for selected candidates, and no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the test and interview.
